text:
Ben Ortiz: quick heads-up — we have a runtime patch roll tonight at 00:30 UTC to address a tokenizer edge-case. planning a canary -> region roll. need final statuspage snippet and customer-facing line for the digest.

Alice Chen: thanks. can we keep a soft pin on the previous runtime for 2 hours post-deploy as fallback?

Carla Núñez: +1 on pin. product wants the customer line to emphasize no expected downtime but possible brief throttling. 

Dave Kline: ops note: canary will start in eu-west-1 with 5% traffic, 00:35 UTC. if error rate > 0.5% for 10m we hold and rollback.

DeployBot: deploy started: canary job id=rb-canary-175666 at 00:35 UTC. monitoring hooks attached.

Elaine Park: drafting statuspage snippet below, feel free to tweak: 
```
Planned maintenance: runtime patch deployment — 00:30 UTC. No downtime expected. Users may see brief throttling for up to 5 minutes in affected regions. We'll post updates here and on the status page.
```

Carla Núñez: that reads fine. add a line about support channels for customers on active Dedicated plans.

Elaine Park: updated snippet: 
```
Planned maintenance: runtime patch deployment — 00:30 UTC. No downtime expected. Users may see brief throttling for up to 5 minutes in affected regions. Dedicated customers: open a support ticket for SLA concerns and we'll prioritize. Updates will appear on status.redwood.example and in this thread.
```

Ben Ortiz: ok. also need a short email blurb for the digest: 
```
Subject: Maintenance notice — runtime patch (00:30 UTC)
Body: We will perform a planned runtime patch at 00:30 UTC to address tokenizer reliability. No downtime is expected. You may notice brief throttling for a few minutes. If you rely on Dedicated capacity and need a guaranteed window, reply to this email and we'll arrange a pinned fallback.
```

Alice Chen: add guidance for engineers: pin older runtime with flag `runtime.pin=2024-11-rc2` if you need immediate rollback. ops will hold the pin for 2 hours post-deploy.

Dave Kline: watchlist created: logs -> alert channel, latency, 5xxs. rolling canary now at 00:35.

DeployBot: canary progress update: 25% traffic shifted, 0.02% errors, avg latency +3ms.

Ben Ortiz: perfect. I'll post the statuspage update at 00:33 UTC and queue the digest email. tagging @Carla for final approval before publishing.

Carla Núñez: approved. go ahead. :thumbsup:

DeployBot: canary complete: no anomalies detected. Ready to begin region roll at 01:10 UTC.

Ben Ortiz: publishing statuspage now. URL: http://status.redwood.example/incidents/175666

Elaine Park: saved the email draft to /marketing/digests/runtime-patch-175666 for send after confirmation.

Ben Ortiz: thanks team. standby for any rollback signals.
